_comment: Copy to devices.json (gitignored) and fill in. Reflects the real tailnet (2026-07-01). Macs use classic SSH over the tailnet (App Store Tailscale can't run the Tailscale SSH server); Linux uses Tailscale SSH. ingestToken (optional, per-device) authorizes that device's collector for POST /ingest — generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`, keep it secret (this file is gitignored).

devices.label: Desktop
devices._note: Windows (no tmux) — out of scope for v1
